messages:
Sam W (Sales): handing off Aperture Data -> CS. 50-seat pilot, likely to convert to paid in Q3. Sales notes: they require private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, and KMS/HSM integration. Go-live target ~6 weeks. Renewal discussion in ~8 months, but churn risk if latency >150ms. I’ve attached test results and contact details below.

Priya N (CS): thanks @Sam — picking this up. Can you confirm the contact persons and whether they need an on-site workshop or remote enablement? Also need the staging account creds and the prompt sets they used for eval.

Sam W (Sales): contacts: anna@aperturedata.com (CTO), josh@aperturedata.com (SRE). They requested a 2-hr remote enablement + runbook. Staging API key: stg_key_apr_2026 (shared in 1:1 slack). Prompt set: "ad-indexing-v1"; sample input attached.

Priya N (CS): placing onboarding task in our tracker, assigning owners. @Lena K to create support ticket for SSO/KMS integration and @Marco R for infra prep. Tentative timeline: week 1 SSO setup, week 2 private deploy + smoke tests, week 3 perf tuning.

Lena K (Support): created ticket SUP-12872 for Okta SSO/SCIM + SUP-12873 for KMS integration. Linking to their Okta metadata: https://aperture.okta.com/meta.xml. Noted they need SCIM user provisioning. Ticket comments: "Customer profile: 50 seats, provisioning in waves, need role mapping for admins."

Marco R (Eng Oncall): quick check — do we have a dedicated VPC image for their private deployment or are we doing customer-provided infra? If they're on our private package, I'll queue a pre-warm of a 2-GPU pool. Also need the sample logs that show latency bump.

Sam W (Sales): they want us to host private (Redwood Private). Please proceed with pre-warm. Logs: attached sample latency trace (p95 ~220ms for 1k token queries) — looks like KV cache misses on long prefixed queries.

Marco R (Eng Oncall): noted. I'll enable prefix caching and a conservative batching policy for the pilot. Putting a perf ticket ENG-6721. Can someone paste the exact sample call?

Priya N (CS): sample call (from their test harness):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-mix-1.2",
  "prompt": "<LONG INDEX PREFIX> + query",
  "max_tokens": 1200,
  "stream": false
}
```
They hit it in bursts (30 qps) during ingest.

Marco R (Eng Oncall): that helps. I'll start with batching window=30ms and enable KV prefetch for long prefixes. Also scheduling a canary deploy to avoid noisy neighbor interference.

Lena K (Support): added escalation path into SUP tickets: if perf not within SLO after tuning, escalate to ENG (ENG-6721). Noted expected SLA for pilot: 99.5% uptime and <150ms p95 if possible.

Priya N (CS): next steps summary — (1) ENG: ENG-6721 + pre-warm 2-GPU pool (owner Marco) (2) SUPPORT: SUP-12872/SUP-12873 open and initial scoping (owner Lena) (3) CS: schedule 2-hr enablement session with Anna & Josh (owner Priya) (4) SALES: follow-up on contract/commit (owner Sam). I'll create a shared onboarding doc and invite attendees.

Sam W (Sales): confirming I'll nudge procurement and share contract draft by EOD Monday. Also flagging renewal predictor: free trial quota usage trending low — risk if they don't ramp to pilot.

Priya N (CS): noted — we'll add early engagement checklist (check-in at day 3, day 10) to reduce churn risk. Tagging @Marco R for perf checkpoints after canary.

deploy-bot: Provisioning job started for private pre-warm (job_id: prewarm-2026-04-05-77). Estimated time: ~18m.

Marco R (Eng Oncall): pre-warm confirmed in progress. I'll push interim perf dashboard link once available.

Lena K (Support): added CS and Sales to tickets. Also requested their Okta admin join the SCIM config call — suggested time Thu 10am PT.

Priya N (CS): perfect. I'll schedule the enablement and SCIM call. We'll capture feedback in the onboarding doc and link to the renewal health checklist.

Sam W (Sales): thanks all — leaving owners as noted. Ping me if procurement stalls. :thumbsup:
